title: Pending-Period Reconciliation Credit in Resident Funds Patient Pay Transfers
content:
The patient pay credit that reaches the named charge of a standing Medicaid patient pay transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account includes **the credited reconciliation amount**. It follows the standing of the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage as the approval fixes it, so that the transfer does not change with how far the business office has posted the reconciliation it owes within the trueup days:

| Case and ledger | Credited reconciliation amount |
|---|---|
| the case is eligible and every estimate billed while the case was pending is the same amount | that estimate less the case's patient pay, never below zero, for each month from the eligibility start date's month up to the month before the named month, because the reconciliation reduces each of those months by that much |
| the case is eligible and those estimates differ | the trueup decreases posted on the other charges |
| otherwise | nothing |

The months are counted in calendar months, the eligibility start date's month included and the named month excluded.

## Hypothetical illustration

The notice's patient pay is $1046.18; eligibility starts 1 February; the named month is May.

| Estimates billed while pending | Trueup decreases posted on the other charges | Credited reconciliation amount |
|---|---|---|
| $1260.00 every month | none | $213.82 for each of February, March and April: $641.46 |
| $1260.00 every month | $427.64 | $641.46 (the posted amount does not change it) |
| $1260.00 and $1302.55 | $427.64 | $427.64 |
| $990.00 every month | none | nothing (the estimate is below the patient pay) |
